input.title: Vanguard Marketing Corporation joins FICC GSD Netting System
input.summary: DTCC notice GOV2283-26 announces that Vanguard Marketing Corporation has become a new participant in the Netting System of FICC's Government Securities Division (GSD #94GV), expanding the pool of cleared Treasury participants.
evidence_quotes: New Participant in the Netting System of the Government Securities Division of FICC: Vanguard Marketing Corporation – GSD #94GV
input.notes: DTCC official notice confirming a new GSD netting participant. Vanguard Marketing Corporation is the broker-dealer arm of Vanguard; it is a notable but not a globally systemic dealer, so reach is set to 1/single rather than 2/major_participant. Effect date set to announced date as no separate effective date is stated. This is consistent with the Treasury clearing mandate onboarding wave (FICC-GSD-03) but is a distinct new-participant event, not the same as any recorded event.
